paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n huai thute agen zoh in, Galili gam a kipan apawt a, Jordan lui gal Judia gam ah ahoh hi.
heading: Kimak Thu A Sinsakna / (Mar 10.1-12)
english: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.

paite: Mipi thupitak in azui ua; amaute ahihdam zel hi.
english: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.

paite: Huan Pharisaite akiang ah ahong ua, amah ze-etna ding in, "Bangziak peuh in mi'n azi mak asiang hia?" achi uhi.
english: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”

paite: Ama'n, "Atung a kipan amau bawlpa'n numei leh pasal abawlleh,
english: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,

paite: hiai ziak in pasal in anu leh apa apaisan ding a, azi alen ding.
english: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh’?

paite: Huchi in anih un sapum khat ahong hita ding uh, achi chih na sim kei ua hia? Huchi in nih ahita kei ua, sapum khat ahi zawta uhi. Huaiziak in Pathian in agawmsa mihing in khen kei hen," chi in adawng hi.
english: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”

paite: Amau bel akiang ah, "Ahihleh, bangziak a Mosi in kimakna laipiak a mak ding chi a thu pia ahia?" achi uhi.
english: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce and divorce her?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Mosi in na lungtang uh khauh ziak in ei ve na zite uh mak aphal; himahleh atung a kipan huchibang ahi ngei kei hi.
english: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.

paite: Ke'n zaw ka hon chi ahi, kuapeuh kingaihna ziak hilou a, zi ma a midang nei angkawm ahi; maksa nei peuhmah leng angkawm ahi," achi hi.
english: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”

paite: Nungzuite'n akiang ah, "Azi lam thu a pasal huchibang ahihleh kiten louh ahoihzaw," achi uhi.
english: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Huai thu ahihleh, apiaknate kia lou ngal, mi napeuh in apom thei kei ding uh.
english: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.

paite: Michilgeh, anu gilsung ua kipan huchibang a piang himte a-om ua; michilgeh, mihing khut a gehte leng a-om sam ua; michilgeh van-gam ziak a chilgeh a kibawltawmte leng a-om sam uhi. Kuapeuh apom thei in pom hen," achi hi.
english: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”

paite: Huai lai in atung ua akhut koih a, athumsak ding in, akiang ah naupang neute ahon pi ua; nungzuite'n ana tai uhi.
heading: Jesu'n Naupang Neute Avualzawl / (Mar 10.13-16; Luk 18.15-17)
english: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n, "Naupang neute ka kiang ah hon paisak unla, kham kei un; van-gam hichibang mite a ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”

paite: Huan atung uah akhut akoih a, huai a pan in apaita hi.
english: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.

paite: Huan mi khat akiang ah ahong a, "Pu, tangtawn hinna ka neihtheihna ding in thil hoih bang ka hih ding?" achi hi.
heading: Tangval Hausa Gentehna / (Mar 10.17-31; Luk 18.18-30)
english: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Thil hoih thu bangziak a hon dong? Hoih khat kia a-om; himahleh, hinna a na lut utleh thupiakte zui in," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Akoi pen maw?" achi hi. Jesu'n, "Tual na that ding ahi kei; Ang na kawm ding ahi kei; Na gu ding ahi kei; Na hek ding ahi kei;
english: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’

paite: Na nu leh na pa zahtak in, chihte leh nangmah na ki-it bang in na vengte na it ding ahi chih," achi hi.
english: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”

paite: Tangval in akiang ah, "Huaite teng ka zui zel; bang ka sam lai a?" achi hi.
english: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Hoihkim a om na utleh, pai inla, na neih tengteng zuak inla, mizawngte kiang ah pia in, huchi in van ah gou na nei ding; huan, hong pai inla, hon zui in," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”

paite: Tangval bel mihausa ahih ziak in, huai thu azak in lungkhamtak in apaimangta hi.
english: But when the young man heard this, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.

paite: Jesu'n anungzuite kiang ah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, mihausa a dia van-gam lut haksapi ahi.
english: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.

paite: Huan ka hon hilh ahi, Pathian lalgam a mihausa alut sang in phimbil a sangawngsau lutsuak abaihlamzaw," achi hi.
english: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

paite: Huan nungzuite'n huai azak un, lamdang asa mahmah ua, "Kua hotdam in a-om zou dia?" achi uhi.
english: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”

paite: Jesu'n amau a-en a, akiang uah, "Huai mihing hih vual ahi kei, Pathian a di'n bangkim hihtheih ahi," achi hi.
english: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

paite: Peter in akiang ah, "Ngai dih, kou bangkim paisan in ka hon zuita ua; bang ka mu ding ua?" chi in adong hi.
english: Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything and followed you. What then will we have?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, "Khovel thak ah, athupina tutphah a Mihing Tapa atut chiang in, nou kei hon zuite, Israel nam sawm-le-nihte tung a vaihawm in, laltutphah sawm-le-nih ah na tu sam ding uhi.
english: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

paite: Huan michih a-innte, a-unaute, asanggamnute, apa, anu, atate, agamte ka min ziak a paisan peuhmah in aleh za amu ding ua, tangtawn hinna atang ding uh.
english: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.

paite: Himahleh mi tampi, amasapen a omte, ananungpen ah a-om ding ua; ananungpen a omte leng amasapen ah a-om ding uh," achi hi.
english: But many will be last who are first, and first who are last.
